m: परि-शाश्वत mfn. continuing for ever, perpetually the same, MBh.
a: परिशाश्वत — a. (ती f.) Perpetually the same.

m: परि-शाप m. id., W.
परि-शायन See परि-शी.
परि-शायन n. causing to lie completely in, complete immersion, Baudh.
परि-√ शॄ Pass. -शीर्यते (ep. also ˚ति), to be cleft or rent asunder, to be split, MBh.
परि-√ शी Ā. -शेते (impf. 3. pl. अशेरन्; 2. du. -अशायतम्; 3. sg. -अशायत), to lie round or near or in, surround, remain lying, RV.; TS.; ŚBr.
परि-√ शील् P. -शीलयति, to practise, use frequently, Kāv.; to treat well, cherish, Prasann.
परि-शीलन n. touch, contact (lit. and fig.), intercourse with, application or attachment to, pursuit of (comp.), constant occupation, study, Kāv.; Sāh.
a: परिशीलनं — 1 Touch, contact (lit.). ललितलवंगलतापरिशीलनकोमलमलयसभीरे Gīt. 1; so वदनकमलपरिशीलनभिलित &c. 11. --2 Constant contact, intercourse, or correspondence. --3 Study, application or attachment (to a thing), steady or fixed pursuit; काव्यार्थ˚ S. D.

m: परि-शीलित mfn. practised, used, employed, pursued, studied, Kāv.
inhabited, Pāṇ. iv, 2, 52, Sch.
परि-शून्य mfn. quite empty, (ifc.) totally free from or devoid of Ragh.
a: परिशून्य — a. 1 Quite empty; R. 8. 66. --2 Quite free from, completely devoid of; 19. 6.

परिशंक् — {c1c} A. 1 To suspect, believe, fancy (to be); पत्रेऽपि संचारिणि प्राप्तंत्वां परिशंकते Gīt. 6. --2 To doubt, have doubts about. --3 To fear, be afraid of; तृणबिंदोः परिशंकितः पुरा R. 8. 79.
परिशंकिन् — a. Fearing, apprehensive.

m: परि-√ शङ्क् Ā. -शङ्कते (inf. -शङ्कितुम्), to suspect, doubt, distrust (acc.), MBh.; R. &c.; to believe, fancy to be (2 acc.), ib.
परि-शङ्का f. suspicion, distrust, Jātakam.
hope, expectation, R.

s: tri, (pariSaNkyate iti । pari + SaNka + anIyar .) sarvvatoBAvena SaNkAvizayaH । yaTA, “SAstraM sucintitamapi praticintanIyamArADito'pi nfpatiH pariSaNkanIyaH । aNke sTitApi yuvatiH parirakzaRIyA SAstre nfpe ca yuvatO ca kuto vaSitvam ॥” ityudBawaH ॥
m: परि-शङ्कनीय mfn. to be doubted or distrusted or feared or apprehended (n. impers. ‘distrust must be felt’), Kāv.; Pur.
परि-शङ्किन् mfn. fearing, apprehending, Ragh.
afraid on account of (comp.), BhP.
परि-शङ्कित mfn. suspicious, distrustful, afraid of (abl. or comp.), MBh.; R.; Pur.
suspected, questionable, MBh.
believed, expected (अ-परिश्˚), MBh.
thought to be, taken for (nom.), Gīt.
परि-शठ mfn. thoroughly dishonest or wicked, Car.
परि-शब्दित mfn. (√ शब्द्) mentioned, communicated, MBh.
परि-शक्तवे inf. of परि-√ शक्, to overpower, to conquer, RV.
परि-शमित mfn. (√ शम्, Caus.) allayed, quenched, destroyed, Gīt.
परि-शन्न mfn. (√ शद्) fallen away or by the side, ĀśvŚr.
परि-√ शप् P. Ā. -शपति, ˚ते, to curse, execrate, TāṇḍBr.; to abuse, revile (aor. पर्य्-अशाप्सीत्), Bhaṭṭ.
परि-शप्त n. cursing, reviling, anathema, TāṇḍBr.
परि-शेषात् ind. consequently, therefore, Śaṃk.
परि-शेष mfn. left over, remaining, ŚāṅkhŚr.; Var.
परि-शेष m. n. remnant, remains, rest, MBh.; Var.
परि-शेष m. supplement, sequel, MBh.
termination, conclusion, L.
a: परि(री)शेषः — 1 Remainder, remnant. --2 Supplement. --3 Termination, conclusion, completion. ( परिशेषेण ind. 1 With the residue. --2 Completely, in full.)

m: परि-शेष—खण्ड m. or n. N. of wk.
परि—शेषण n. remainder, residue, BhP.
a: परिशेषणं — Remainder, residue.

m: परि-शेष—शास्त्र n. a supplementary work, L.
परि-शेष—वत् mfn. having a supplement or appendix, Cat.
परि-शेषेण ind. completely, in full
परि-शेषित mfn. left over, remaining from (comp.), BhP.
परि-शृत m. or n. (√ श्रा ?) ardent spirits, liquor, L. (cf. परि-स्रुत्, -स्रुता under परि-स्रु).
a: परिशृतः — Ardent spirits.

m: परि-शिथिल mfn. very loose or lax, Jātakam.
परि-शिञ्जित mfn. (√ शिञ्ज्) made to hum or resound from all sides, MBh.

परि-√ शिष् P. -शिनष्टि (Pot. -शिंष्युः), to leave over, leave as a remainder, Br.; Ā. (pf. -शिशिषे, ˚षिरे; fut. -शेक्ष्यते) and Pass. -शिष्यते (p. -शिष्यमाण), to be left as a remainder, 10 remain behind, AV. &c. &c.: Caus. -शेषयति, to leave over, suffer to remain, spare, Ragh.; Rājat.; Pur.; to quit or leave, Bhaṭṭ.; to supply, L.
a: परिशिष् — {c7c} P. 1 To leave remaining (caus. also); भविता करेणुपंरिशेषिता मही Bv. 1. 53. --2 To quit or leave (a place).

s: klI, (paritaH SizwaH । Siz + ktaH .) pariSezaviSizwam । avaSizwArTaboDakagranTaH । iti hemacandraH । 2 । 171 ॥ (yaTA, CAndogapariSizwam । gfhyapariSizwamityAdi ॥)
v: tri॰ pari + Siza--kta । 1 avaSeze । tataH astvarTe ac । 2 tatprakASakagranTaBede na॰ temaya॰ yaTA nfhyapariSizwaM CandogapariSizwam ityAdi ।
m: परि-शिष्ट (परि-), mfn. left, remaining, TS.; &c.
परि-शिष्ट n. a supplement, appendix (N. of a class of works supplementary to Sūtras)
a: परिशिष्ट — a. 1 Left, remaining. --2 Finished. --ष्टं A supplement, an appendix; as in गृह्यपरिशिष्ट.

m: परि-शिष्ट—कदम्ब m. n. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—पर्वन् n. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—पर्याय m. pl. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—प्रबोध m. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—प्रकाश m. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—प्रकाशस्य-सार-मञ्जरी f. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—सूत्र-पत्त्र n. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—संग्रह m. N. of wk.
परि-शिष्ट—सिद्धान्त-रत्नाकर m. N. of wk.
परि-श्लथ mfn. quite loose or relaxed, Vcar.
परि-श्लेष m. an embrace, ib.
a: परिश्लेषः — Au embrace.

m: परि-श्लिष्ट mfn. (√ श्लिष्) clasped, embraced, W.
परि-शोभित mfn. adorned or beautified by (instr. or comp.), Hariv.; R.
परि-शोभित—काया f. N. of an Apsaras and a Gandharvī, Kāraṇḍ.

s: puM, (pari + SuD + BAve GaY .) pariSoDanam । sarvvatoBAvena SudDiH ॥
v: pu॰ pari + BAve GaY । 1 fRAdeH SoDane । Ric aca । 2 paritaH SudDisampAdane ca । lyuw । pariSoDana tatrArTe na॰ ।
m: परि-शोध m. = next, W.
a: परिशोधः, परिशोधनं — 1 Purifying, cleansing. --2 Rectifying, correcting. --3 Quittance, discharging or paying off (a debt or obligation).

m: परि-शोधन n. cleaning, purification, Uttarar.
discharging, paying off, Kull.

s: puM, (pari + Suz + BAve GaY .) sarvvatoBAvena SuzkatA । (yaTA, goH rAmAyaRe । 4 । 15 । 34 । “vAyvarkaparipItAmburviparimlAnapaNkajaH । taqAga iva kAlena pariSozaM gamizyati ॥”)
m: परि-शोष m. complete dryness, desiccation, evaporation (˚षं-√ गम्, to become dry or thin), R.; Suśr.
a: परिशोषः — Act of being completely dried or parched up.

m: परि-शोषण mfn. drying up, parching, MBh. (v.l. ˚षिन्)
परि-शोषण n. drying, parching, emaciating, MBh.
परि-शोषिन् mfn. becoming dry or withered, shrivelling, Rājat.
v.l. for ˚शोषण, MBh.
परि-शोषित mfn. dried up, parched, Cat.

a: परिश्रांतिः — f. 1 Fatigue, weariness, trouble, exhaustion. --2 Labour, exertion.

m: परि-श्राम m. fatiguing, occupation, trouble, BhP.

s: tri, (pari + Srama + karttari ktaH .) sarvvatoBAvena SrAntiyuktaH । (yaTA, mahABArate । 1 । 49 । 26 । “pariSrAnto vayaHsTaSca zazwivarzo jarAnvitaH । kzuDitaH sa mahAraRye dadarSa munisattamam ॥” strI । gAyatrIsvarUpA BagavatI । yaTA, devIBAgavate । 12 । 6 । 93 । “pAvanI pAdasahitA peSalA pavanASinI । prajApatiH pariSrAntA parvvatastanamaRqalA ॥”)
m: परि-श्रान्त mfn. thoroughly fatigued or worn out, (ifc.) tired of, disgusted with, Mn.; MBh. &c.
परि-श्रान्ति f. fatigue, exhaustion
labour, trouble, W.
परि-√ श्रम् (only ind.p. -श्रम्य), to fatigue or exert one's self, R. : Caus. -श्रमयति, to fatigue, tire, Naiṣ.
परि-श्र˚मापह mfn. relieving weariness, MW.

s: puM, (pari + Sram + GaY । na vfdDiH .) pariSrAntiH । tatparyyAyaH । SramaH 2 klamaH 3 kleSaH 4 prayAsaH 5 AyAsaH 6 vyAyAmaH 7 । iti hemacandraH । 2 । 233 ॥ (yaTA, raGuH । 1 । 58 । “tamAtiTyakriyASAnta-raTakzoBapariSramam । papracCa kuSalaM rAjye rAjyASramamuniM muniH ॥”)
v: pu॰ pari + ama--GaYa na vfdDiH । 1 vyAnAme kleSaArake AyAse hemaca॰ । Arze tu kvacit vfdDiH । pariSrAma tatrArTe BAga॰ 2 । 9 । 20
m: परि-श्रम m. fatigue, exertion, labour, fatiguing occupation, trouble, pain, MBh.; Kāv. &c.
a: परिश्रमः — 1 Fatigue, exhaustion, trouble, pain; आत्मा परिश्रमस्य पदमुपनीतः Ś. 1; R. 1. 58; 11. 12. --2 Exertion, labour. --3 (Hence) Close application to or study of, being constantly occupied with; आर्ये कृतपरिश्रमोस्मि चतुःषष्ट्यंगे ज्योतिःशास्त्रे Mu. 1.

m: परि-श्रमण mfn. (?) free from fatigue or weariness, BhP., Sch.

s: puM, (pariSrayatyasmin iti । pari + Sri + “erac .” 3 । 3 । 56 । iti ac .) saBA । (BAve ac .) ASrayaH । iti medinI । ye । 122 ॥
v: pu॰ pari + Sri--ADAre ac । 1 ASrave 2 saBAyAM ca medi॰ ।
m: परि-श्रय m. an enclosure, fence (in स-परिश्˚), ŚBr.
a refuge, asylum, Pañc. (B.), i, 252
an assembly, meeting, L.
N. of a prince, VP.
a: परिश्रयः — 1 A meeting, an assembly. --2 Refuge, asylum; Pt. 1. 252. --3 Ved. A fence.

m: परि-श्रयण n. encompassing, surrounding with a fence, KātyŚr., Sch.
a: परिश्रयणं — Encompassing.

m: परि-√ श्रि P. -श्रयति (ind.p. -श्रित्य; Ved. inf. परि-श्रयितवै), to surround, encircle, fence, enclose, TS.; Br.; ŚrS. : Pass. -श्रीयस्व, be surrounded or surround thyself, VS. xxxvii, 13.

v: strI pariSrayatyanayA pari + Sri--karaRe kvip । sUkzmapAzARe Sata॰ brA॰ 7 । 1 । 12 BAzyam । 2 yajYiyezwakAsamasaMKyake pAzARaKaRqe ca kAtyA॰ SrO॰ 18 । 6 । 1 3
m: परि-श्रित् f. pl. ‘enclosers’, N. of certain small stones laid round the hearth and other parts of an altar, ŚBr.; KātyŚr. (ifc. ˚श्रित्क).
a: परिश्रित् — f. Ved. Small stones laid round the altar.

v: tri॰ pari + Sri + kta । 1 samASrite BAve kta । 2 ASraye na॰ । 3 paritovezwane 4 vfzwyAdiparihArake tiraskaraRyAdiBirvezwane Sata॰ brA॰ 3 । 1 । 2 । 8 BA॰ । ASva॰ SrO॰ 2 । 4 । 1 nArA॰ ।
m: परि-श्रित mfn. standing round, MBh.
surrounded by (instr. or comp.), Kathās.; BhP.
w.r. for ˚श्रुत, MBh.
परि-श्रित (परि-) n. = परि-वृत n. (see under परि- √ 1. वृ), TS.; Br.; ŚrGṛS.
परि-√ श्रु P. -शृणोति (ind.p. -श्रुत्य), to hear, learn, understand, R.
परि-श्रुत mfn. heard, learnt, MBh.; R.; Hariv.
known as, passing for (nom.), ib.
famous, celebrated, MBh.; BhP.
w.r. for प्रति-श्˚, MBh.
परि-श्रुत m. N. of an attendant of Skanda, ib.
परि-√ शुभ् (शुम्भ्) P. -शुम्भति, to prepare, AV.; Ā. -शोभते, to shine, be bright or beautiful, MBh.

परि-√ शुध् P. Ā. -शुध्यति, ˚ते, to be washed off, become clean or purified, Subh.; (Ā.) to purify or justify one's self, prove one's innocence, Rājat. : Caus. -शोधयति, to clear, clean, R.; to clear off, restore, Yājñ. ii, 146; to try, examine, Kathās.; to solve, explain, clear up, Gīt.
a: परिशुध् — Caus. 1 To purify completely. --2 To explain, clear up.

m: परि-शुश्रूषा See परि-श्रु.
परि-शुश्रूषा f. complete or implicit obedience, Śukas.
परि-√ शुच् P. Ā. -शोचति, ˚ते, to mourn, wail, lament (trans. and intrans.), MBh. : Caus. -शोचयति (ind.p. -शोच्य), to pain, torment, MBh. (B.) vi, 1902; to lament, bewail, MBh. vii, 10.
परि-शुद्ध mfn. cleaned, purified, pure
cleared off, paid
acquitted, discharged, MBh.; Kāv.; Pur.
(ifc.) diminished by, that from which a part has been taken away, MBh.
a: परिशुद्ध — p. p. 1 Cleaned, purified. --2 Acquitted, discharged. --3 Cleared off, paid.

m: परि-शुद्धि f. complete purification or justification, acquittal (˚धिं-√ कृ, to prove one's innocence), Ragh.; Bālar.; Kathās.
rightness, correctness, Kāraṇḍ.
a: परिशुद्धिः — f. 1 Complete purification; अग्नि˚ U. 4. --2 Justification; acquittal.

m: परि-√ शुष् P. Ā. -शुष्यति, ˚ते, to be thoroughly dried up, to shrivel, wither (lit. and fig.), pine, waste away, MBh.; Kāv. &c.: Caus. -शोषयति (Pass. -शोष्यते), to dry up, emaciate, Kāv.; Pañc.; Suśr.
a: परिशुष् — {c4c} P. 1 To be dried up, dry up; Bk. 10. 41; Bg. 1. 29. --2 To pine, decay, wither. --3 To be afflicted. --Caus. To emaciate.

s: klI, (paritaH Suzkam । Suz + ktaH .) mAMsavyaYjanaBedaH । yaTA, -- “mAMsaM bahuGftErBfzwaM siktaYceccAmbunA muhuH । jIrakAdyEH samAyuktaM pariSuzkaM taducyate ॥” iti SabdacandrikA ॥ sarvvatonIrase tri ॥ (yaTA, heH rAmAyaRe । 2 । 59 । 5 । “upataptodakA nadyaH palvalAni sarAMsi ca । pariSuzkapalASAni vanAnyupavanAni ca ॥”)
v: tri॰ pari + Suza--kta tasya kaH । 1 zaritaH Sozayute 2 nIrase “mAMsaM bahuGftErBfzwaM siktaYcedambunA muhuH । jIrakAdyEH samAyuktaM pariSuzkaM taducyate” Sabdaca॰ ukte 3 praripakvamAMsaBede na॰ ।
m: परि-शुष्क mfn. thoroughly dried or parched up, withered, shrivelled, shrunk (as a vein), hollow (as the cheeks) &c., MBh.; Kāv.; Var.; Suśr.
परि-शुष्क n. (with मांस) meat fried in ghee dried and spiced, L.
a: परिशुष्क — p. p. 1 Thoroughly dried, completely dried or parched up; तृषा महत्या परिशुष्कतालवः Rs. 1. 11. --2 Withered, shrivelled, hollow (as cheeks). --ष्कं A kind of fried meat.

m: परि-शुष्क—पलाश mfn. having withered foliage, R.
परि-शुष्क—तालु mfn. having the palate dried up, Ṛt.
